items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued August 2 at 5:16AM AKDT until August 3 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels as high as 1 to 3 feet above normal
highest tide line.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Sunday to 7 PM Monday.

* IMPACTS...There is potential for coastal erosion due to high
surf. Coastal flooding is possible during high tide.

items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A high surf advisory means that high surf will affect beaches in
the advisory area, producing rip currents and localized beach
erosion.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued August 2 at 5:14AM AKDT until August 6 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Seward

* WHEN...From Monday evening through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Isolated landslides possible in areas of steep terrain.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- An atmospheric river of moisture moving over the southern
Kenai Peninsula will result in moderate to heavy rain for

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 2 at 4:41AM AKDT until August 2 at 9:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

Valley.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 1 at 2:13PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
As a coastal system moves across Western Alaska Sunday into
Monday, it will bring widespread rain well inland. Rain totals
from Sunday night through early Tuesday morning are expected to
range from 1 to 2 inches across the Central Interior. River levels
will rise with this rainfall, although no flooding is expected at
this time.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 1 at 12:57PM AKDT until August 5 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 50 mph with gusts up to 70 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From 10 PM Sunday to 4 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Gusty winds could blow around
unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power
outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
